title: Colossus
description: You receive [blue]50%[/blue] less damage from [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] enemies this turn.
smart_description: You receive [blue]50%[/blue] less damage from [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] enemies this turn (lasts for additional turns based on stack count).
notes: Counter-type power that decrements each enemy turn. Only reduces damage from attacks by enemies with Vulnerable status. Applies a multiplicative damage reduction.
